key_insight: HT-PAder gives the first parameter-free dynamic regret guarantee for online convex optimization with heavy-tailed noise by combining restarted AdaGrad experts with a meta-algorithm over block lengths.
engineering_relevance: This matters for adaptive optimization systems facing nonstationary data and outlier-prone gradients, since it achieves strong regret without knowing horizon, noise level, or path length in advance.
method: Restarted AdaGrad experts run over a geometric pool of block lengths.
AdaGrad-Hedge aggregates the experts pathwise without requiring moment conditions on meta-losses.
The analysis covers heavy-tailed stochastic gradients with only a finite p-th central moment.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports an expected universal dynamic regret bound of ~O(GD√(T(1+P_T/D)) + σDT^{1/p}(1+P_T/D)^{(p-1)/p}), plus a matching lower bound showing optimality of the path-length exponent.
watch_item: The guarantee is asymptotic and hides logarithmic factors, so practical performance may depend on tuning details and the behavior of the heavy-tailed noise in finite samples.
paper_title: Parameter-Free Dynamic Regret for Online Convex Optimization under Heavy-Tailed Noise
